targets.name: pricing_router
targets.title: B2B SaaS pricing compliance & LLM router cost optimization
targets.summary: Preserve exact German/EU VAT (domestic 19%, reverse charge, OSS at the buyer's standard rate, non-EU export), discount rules and task quality SLAs while minimizing total LLM eval cost units.
targets.approach: Export routeAndPrice(scenario) with zero comments, imports, or dynamic eval. It runs in a sandboxed child process and must match the oracle on 240 golden plus 2,184 fresh scenarios (boundary values, every supported country) while lowering the model cost by at least 5% on both the golden and the fresh suite.
